metadata.description: Live mods for Claude Code: plan limits that tell you how long they will last, hand-offs between machines, Unity and Blender helpers

plugins.name: usage-limits
plugins.description: Limites de 5h e semanal, custo, duração estimada, orçamento por projeto e recomendação de modelo

plugins.name: fluxo
plugins.description: Passagem de bastão entre máquinas (/handoff) e aviso quando um turno longo termina

plugins.name: tarefas
plugins.description: Project tasks in a TASKS.md: a pane, the next task above the prompt, and Claude creating and finishing tasks

plugins.name: roadmap
plugins.description: Project roadmap in a JSON or a plain ROADMAP.md: the phases as a trail and the work as a kanban board, phase and progress above the prompt, an out-of-date warning, and Claude checking items off

plugins.name: unity-tools
plugins.description: Unity: erros de compilação no contexto, testes em batch, build do servidor e guardas de arquivos

plugins.name: blender-preview
plugins.description: Prévia da cena do Blender e checagem de GLB contra os orçamentos do jogo
